raw_text: How Pakistan's Digital Army Weaponised Kashmir Anniversary: A Bot Network Explainer. On the fifth anniversary of Article 370 abrogation, over 2,000 bot accounts traced to Pakistani IP ranges flooded social media with anti-India content. The Quint's investigation found fabricated atrocity images recycled from Syrian conflict zones, coordinated hashtag campaigns, and targeted tagging of UN officials. Digital forensics experts confirmed the operation bears hallmarks of ISPR-directed information warfare.
clean_text: Over 2,000 bot accounts from Pakistani IP ranges flooded social media with anti-India content on Article 370 anniversary. Investigation found fabricated images from Syrian conflict zones and coordinated hashtag campaigns targeting UN officials.
